baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence of dispatching, earth-searching, and making him see how to cover.
baseline_models.mechanism: A directed agent performs a visible ground action so that concealed practical knowledge becomes observable and repeatable.

activation_trace.role: Directed sending makes the bird's arrival part of an arranged demonstration.
Physical disturbance of soil supplies the demonstration's concrete procedure.
Causing something to become visible turns motion into instruction.
Putting something behind visibility supplies both the task taught and the task repeated.

changed_reading.before: A crow happens to scratch the ground and the killer notices a burial technique.
changed_reading.after: The scene is an enacted lesson: a dispatched creature externalizes hidden know-how as a visible sequence the killer can repeat.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The self-question about inability, being like this crow, and then performing the crow's covering action.
baseline_models.mechanism: The comparison exposes a deficit and immediately converts resemblance into procedural imitation; the human can recover one minimal act only by taking the animal as model.

activation_trace.role: Failure or shortfall names the exposed incapacity rather than mere ignorance.
Resemblance establishes the bird as the comparison against which human capacity is measured.
Pattern-following turns likeness from a description into an executable response.
The literal crow remains the concrete nonhuman exemplar, preventing the model from becoming an abstract comparison.

changed_reading.before: The killer is embarrassed that a bird knows a technique he does not.
changed_reading.after: His question diagnoses a practical and moral shortfall: he must lower himself into disciplined imitation before he can perform even the minimum care owed to his brother's body.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled covering of the brother's concealed vulnerability followed by becoming one of the regretful.
baseline_models.mechanism: The body can be moved out of sight, but the action leaves a residue in the actor; material concealment transfers rather than extinguishes the evidence of rupture.

activation_trace.role: Removal from view supplies the successful outward operation.
A vulnerability that calls for concealment identifies what the outward operation protects.
Repeated kinship keeps the violated relation visible even when the body is hidden.
A remaining mark gives regret the functional role of inward residue after outward covering.

changed_reading.before: Burial closes the visible problem and is followed by remorse.
changed_reading.after: Covering resolves exposure but not the breach: the brother disappears from sight while an enduring trace appears in the killer as regret.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pre-focus context contrasts an arm readily extended for killing and a self that makes killing easy with the focus's inability to perform a covering act until a bird demonstrates it. Bodily agency is present throughout; its moral direction is reversed.

activation_trace.role: Working the soil supplies a constructive use of embodied action.
Shortfall locates the problem in what the killer cannot direct himself to do.
Taking life defines the destructive endpoint of the opposed bodily choices.
Extension of the hand makes agency spatial and contrasts the threatened and withheld actions.
The bodily hand is the available instrument whose use, not existence, differentiates the brothers.
The self's making an act easy supplies the asymmetry between facilitated violence and blocked care.
The inward faculty supplies the site at which destructive action is authorized.

structural_cues: 5:28 repeats the extended hand in opposed first- and second-person positions.
5:30 places self-facilitation immediately before the completed killing.
5:31 answers that ease with a first-person confession of inability and an imitated ground action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed hands, self-facilitated killing, and later incapacity; I infer that the crow redirects already-available agency rather than supplying raw motor capacity. A live alternative is that the contrast concerns knowledge alone.

changed_reading.before: The killer simply lacks burial knowledge.
changed_reading.after: He does not lack agency: the same embodied capacity was easy to direct toward death but cannot be directed toward minimal care until an animal retrains it by example.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated becoming-language first classifies the killer among the losers and then among the regretful. Later context explicitly couples turning back with repair, so regret is an added aftermath state rather than proof that the prior loss has been reversed.

activation_trace.role: Becoming marks entry into the first post-killing status.
General diminution names the loss already in force before the crow appears.
The repeated becoming construction adds a second status without grammatically canceling the first.
Pain over what has passed supplies recognition after the irreversible act.
Restoration opposed to corruption supplies the corrective component that regret alone does not state.

structural_cues: 5:30 and 5:31 close with the same verbal frame and different group predicates.
The focus reports regret but no object, speech, or act of repair beyond covering the body.
5:39 coordinates turning back with making right.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two consecutive status changes and a later repair condition; I infer accumulation rather than substitution, so regret does not erase loss. It may still be the beginning of a genuine turn, which remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The final regret completes a repentance arc.
changed_reading.after: Regret is real recognition but remains an aftermath category layered onto loss; the pericope withholds completed repair.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate causal opening after the focus carries the hidden body and private regret into a binding rule about life. The burial scene therefore functions as a hinge from singular aftermath to publicly fixed protection.

activation_trace.role: The repeatedly named brother keeps the initiating loss singular and relational.
Retrospective pain closes the private episode but cannot restore the life.
Explicit causation makes the preceding event generate what follows.
A fixed and obligating prescription converts discovered consequence into public norm.
The life-bearing self identifies what the rule protects beyond disposal of a body.
Preserving life supplies the positive reversal that burial itself cannot achieve.

structural_cues: 5:32 immediately follows the focus and opens with a backward-pointing causal phrase.
The focus repeats one brother's body; 5:32 contrasts one life with humanity as a whole.
The sequence moves from hiding a killed body to preserving living persons.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direct causation, binding prescription, singular life, and preservation; I infer that the crow episode is a juridical hinge, not merely narrative cleanup. The causal pointer could include the wider fratricide story rather than 5:31 alone.

changed_reading.before: The crow episode is an epilogue that handles the corpse.
changed_reading.after: It is the last private scene before the killing becomes public norm: failed care for one brother opens into a rule designed to preserve every life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same earth that receives the crow's searching and the brother's covering is immediately named as the field in which corruption operates and from which offenders may be removed. Soil expands into a social-juridical arena.

activation_trace.role: The literal lower ground supplies the material medium of the lesson.
Disturbing soil makes the ground active rather than a neutral backdrop.
Repeated ground-language carries the focus's material setting into the sphere of human excess.
The same domain becomes both the arena of action and the domain from which removal occurs.
Departure from sound order turns a local grave-site action into part of a wider damaged field.

structural_cues: 5:31 locates the bird's demonstration in the earth.
5:32 twice situates killing, corruption, and excess in the earth.
5:33 pairs acting corruptly in the earth with expulsion from it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated earth-locations and corruption; I infer continuity of domain from soil to public order. The live alternative is that the repeated term is only ordinary location and carries no personified or witnessing force.

changed_reading.before: Earth is merely the substrate used to hide the corpse.
changed_reading.after: The earth receives the concealed body but also names the public field damaged by the killing; burial localizes remains without localizing the act's consequences.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later branches separate several operations that all touch concealment or removal of stain: protecting a vulnerable body from view, shielding a wrongdoer from sin's effect, obscuring truth, repairing corruption, and cleansing the interior. The object and consequence of covering determine its moral direction.

activation_trace.role: Physical concealment supplies the morally ambiguous base operation.
The brother's vulnerable remains make one form of covering an act of bodily care.
Protective covering of sin and its effects supplies a form of concealment that preserves the person.
Obscuring truth supplies the contrary moral direction of a covering act.
Restoring soundness supplies the action that must accompany a genuine turn.
Cleansing self and deed from wrong distinguishes inward repair from merely hiding an exterior.

structural_cues: 5:34 places forgiving protection after prior turning.
5:41 contrasts speech at the mouth with belief in the heart and names failed inner purification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinct cover, truth-obscuring, repair, and purification images; I infer a moral taxonomy based on what is hidden and what is restored. A live alternative keeps the focus's burial vocabulary materially literal and declines the cross-root analogy.

changed_reading.before: Covering the body is either simple closure or evidence that the killer now repents.
changed_reading.after: The burial is necessary care but morally underdetermined: hiding remains is not the same as hiding truth, receiving forgiveness, repairing wrong, or cleansing the heart.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later trace-following and clear-path images sharpen the focus's combination of 'how' and 'like': the relevant resemblance is acquired by tracking an exemplar's visible procedure, not by sharing its identity.

activation_trace.role: Making the action visible supplies a procedure that can be followed.
Following a model gives functional content to being like the crow.
Following a predecessor's track supplies the later pericope's model of guided succession.
A remaining sign of what preceded supplies the trace by which imitation stays oriented.
A manifest route supplies the endpoint of converting example into procedure.

structural_cues: The focus asks how, then asks about being like, then repeats the demonstrated verb.
5:46 combines succession with traces left by predecessors.
5:48 names a manifest way within differentiated norms.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible showing, model-following, predecessor-traces, and a clear route; I infer that the killer seeks procedural likeness. The live alternative hears 'like this crow' only as a humiliating species comparison.

changed_reading.before: Being like the crow is a general comparison expressing humiliation.
changed_reading.after: Likeness is narrowly operational: he becomes like the crow only by following its visible track and reproducing its way of covering.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The analogy is surprising because it places an animal performance beside dispatched messengers and clarifying signs. It remains anchored in God's sending of the crow specifically to make something visible, and in the immediate context's delivery vocabulary. Downstream prose must call the crow a nonverbal sign or messenger-analogue, never assign it prophetic or technical messenger status.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: God dispatches the crow and makes its action show the killer how.

activation_trace.role: Directed sending gives the bird a task-bearing arrival.
Caused visibility makes the performed action carry intelligible content.
Message-bearing envoys supply the formal delivery pattern to which the bird is only analogically compared.
Meaning disclosed through a sign supplies the bird's nonverbal communicative function.

changed_reading.before: The bird is an accidental natural example.
changed_reading.after: The bird can be carried as a providentially dispatched, nonverbal sign whose performed message is a procedure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain structural comparison, not a claim that resemblance and retaliation are lexical equivalents. It remains anchored in the killer's attempt to become like the crow and in the later body's exact life-for-life measure. Downstream prose should present it as an exploratory contrast: procedural imitation can cover remains but cannot furnish an equivalent restoration of life.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The killer can achieve likeness to the crow only in the act of covering his brother.

activation_trace.role: Resemblance supplies the limited equivalence the killer can actually perform.
Covering defines the narrow practical result of that resemblance.
Life itself supplies the value that burial cannot return.
Measured equivalence of injury supplies the legal contrast to the focus's merely procedural likeness.

changed_reading.before: Copying the crow solves the remaining practical problem.
changed_reading.after: The copied act closes only the grave: the later measure of life against life exposes the irreparable gap between performing a likeness and restoring the brother.

strongest_changes: The crow redirects agency that was already available for killing but unavailable for care.
The episode becomes a causal hinge from one hidden body to a binding norm that protects life.
Regret is an added aftermath state, not yet the repair later context requires.
Physical covering separates into care, truth-obscuring, forgiving protection, and inner purification.
summary.what_was_special: The packet made material operations carry the reading: a hand is redirected, earth expands from grave soil to public field, and outward covering leaves an inward trace. It also supports a contained reading of the crow as an embodied procedural sign.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact bodily scope of the doubled concealed vulnerability remains open.
The residual-trace branch of regret may be an image-level activation rather than a semantic claim.
The later trace, path, and equivalence cues may be pericope-wide reverberations rather than direct explanations of 5:31.
